note: Set A captures critical engineering metadata like drawing scales and angle sizes (L3X3X1/4) which Set B misses entirely. Set B contains hallucinated attributes, specifically claiming a 'flange thickness' of 1 1/2" (the angle is L3x3x1/4, so thickness is 1/4") and mislabeling horizontal segment lengths as 'total height'. Set A has one significant binding error (assigning the 2'-3 7/8" dimension to Module B instead of Module A), but its attribute labels are generally safer and more accurate.
